description.value: Tina Cake Desserts is a Vietnamese dessert and food café on Kingsway in East Vancouver, billing itself as the number one Vietnamese desserts and foods spot in the city. The shop specializes in traditional Vietnamese cuisine alongside fresh fruit desserts and ice cream. It sits on a busy arterial corridor with regular cycling traffic between central Vancouver and Burnaby.
